title: Word Generator — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Mixes words and patterns, then creates the thing or program the mixed word describes — a working generator with real demos.
capabilities: Word mixing: blends two or more words by shared sounds, syllables, or meaning.
Pattern extraction: learns prefix/suffix/syllable patterns from word lists.
Pattern application: applies a pattern to new roots to coin consistent new words.
Compound building: joins words into compounds with meaning carried through.
Portmanteau crafting: fuses words at natural sound boundaries.
Description-to-program: turns a word description ("a counter") into a runnable program.
Pronunciation notes: renders phonetic-style pronunciation for coined words.
Name safety check: flags coins that collide with real product or trademark names.

title: Word Generator — Input and output contract
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Inputs: Source words, pattern rules (prefix/suffix/syllable), blend mode, and an optional "make it" target.. Outputs: Coined word(s) with pronunciation and meaning notes, plus — when asked to "make it" — the runnable thing or program it describes..

title: Word Generator — Worked example
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Mix "aqua" (water) with "bot" (robot) at the sound boundary to coin "aquabot", then have the generator CREATE the aquabot: a runnable program that simulates a water-cleaning robot run, executes it, and reports the cleaned volume — word to working program in one step.

title: Word Generator — Safety, limits, and failure modes
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Coined words are labeled as coined, never presented as established vocabulary. The generator avoids trademarked or product-name collisions and flags them. Generated programs are verified by execution before being claimed working; unproven items are labeled unproven, never promised.
